about: BOSS SIGNATURE MECHANICS (Dom 2026-10-28: each boss has its own fighting identity). A map: mechanic id -> its row. A ring boss names its id in data/rings.json bosses[].mechanic (null = none); the code lives in src/fight/mechanics/<id>.ts and is registered in src/fight/mechanics/registry.ts; src/sim/validate.js checkMechanics checks every row. Ticks are 60 Hz, distances metres, stamina on the 0-100 bar. envoy-latch (The Titan's Envoy, parasite): he crouches (a green glow line runs from him to the hero), lunges along it and latches on; while latched the hero's stamina drains to a floor and his walk is slowed until he rolls, lands breakHits cuts inside breakWindowTicks, or maxLatchTicks run out. A guarded lunge or a rolled-away lunge leaves the Envoy open. The latch is a crowd-control kind (cc-defs.json `latch`): the 2nd landing lasts half, the 3rd a quarter, the 4th is a harmless bump.
